text:
maddie: Quick sync — need to lock down quota-tier <> pricing plan bindings before the rollout next Tue. Two main open items: (1) free plan burst semantics (per-key vs per-org pool) and (2) console visibility + telemetry for softcap warnings.

samir: My vote: free = strict per-key burst (no pooling). Prevents single org from gaming multiple free keys. pro/enterprise can opt into per-org pooled bursts. keeps ops headaches low. :+1:

wei: Agree on per-key for free. Also propose a small grace window for all plans: allow X tokens of negative balance for ~60s to accommodate client retry storms, then enforce hard throttle. We can expose `X-Quota-Grace` header.

jun: Can we define the numeric defaults here? e.g. free: burst 5k tokens / minute per-key, no pool; pro: 50k tokens / minute pooled per-org + 10k per-key; enterprise: configurable. Thoughts?

maddie: Those numbers look sensible as a starting point. We'll surface them in the console as "burst allowance" under the plan page. Question: for pro pooled bursts, how do we charge if an org uses > committed capacity during burst? immediate billing vs post-facto metering?

samir: Prefer post-facto metering with alerting. If we auto-bill, sales will get annoyed. Post-facto usage logs + estimated cost alert in console.

ira: For rollout UX: show a clear softcap state in the usage graph with tooltip: "softcap reached — requests will be throttled to baseline after grace window". Also add an action: "request temporary burst" that hits support flow for enterprises.

wei: On telemetry, emit metric `quoter.burst_event` with tags: plan, org_id, key_id, outcome=(allowed|grace|throttled). We'll need a trace link in each throttled response so SRE can jump to sample traces.

maddie: Good. Add a console setting (admin-only) to toggle per-org pooling for pro customers — default ON. We need to document the migration: existing pro customers get pooled automatically unless they opt out within 2 weeks.

sylvia: Migration opt-out UI needs to live under Billing -> Quotas. Also add a small banner email to customers explaining new pooled bursts and how metering works. Email copy should include example: "One-minute spike of 70k tokens consumed — post-facto invoice: $X".

jun: Edge case: shared team keys (multiple apps using same key). If pooled is ON, we might double-count app-level spikes. We should recommend issuing per-app keys and add a console hint: "Use per-app keys to isolate quotas."

samir: Also: implement a fallback policy when throttled: route to a cheaper/quantized model variant automatically (if acceptable) and return `X-Fallback-Model: yes` header when applied. That reduces user impact and cost.

maddie: +1 on fallback. For free plan, fallback is mandatory (we never want long errors). For pro, fallback is opt-in per-route. Enterprise: configurable.

wei: Sample rate-limit response snippet for API team to implement in the SDKs:

```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Content-Type: application/json
X-Quota-Outcome: throttled
X-Quota-Window-Reset: 1670000123
{
  "error": "quota_exceeded",
  "message": "You have hit your burst allowance. Retry after window reset or request a temporary increase.",
  "trace_id": "t-abc123",
  "suggested_fallback": "redwood-v2-small"
}
```

jun: Thanks — SDKs will surface `X-Quota-Outcome` and `trace_id`. We should also include `X-Estimated-Cost-Overage` when post-facto metering applies.

ira: UX note: add a little bell in the console that pings admins when `quoter.burst_event` with outcome=throttled occurs > 5 times in 10m. Reduce noise by sampling for free plans.

sylvia: For billing, set a soft threshold email at 80% of pooled burst and a billing threshold at 100%. Keep the invoice line item labeled "Burst overage (minute windows)".

maddie: All good. Action items:
- samir: write enforcement spec (per-key vs per-org logic + grace window) — due EOD Fri
- wei: telemetry event schema + headers — due Mon
- jun: SDK header handling + sample responses — due Mon
- ira: console UI copy + migration banner draft — due Mon
- sylvia: billing line item wording and email copy — due Mon

quota-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Quota mapping doc review" on 2167950000 (Thu 09:00) :calendar:

maddie: thanks team. If no objections I'll merge the spec on Monday and kick off the canary rollout to 5% of pro orgs. :eyes:

samir: no objections from me.

wei: LGTM.
